gaps: Phase 1 still-port: text layer rise/blur swaps, rollback direction, slot icon spring/blur, drawn-check stroke animation, frame width morph, multiline box height spring, and message reveal height spring render their static end states. The `.reveal`, `.revealInner`, `.message`, `.layer` and `.text` elements are kept so Phase 2 wires motion without restructuring.
The `.reveal` wrapper stays mounted with the message rendered conditionally inside (ARC animates its height from zero); an empty reveal renders no visible row.
Typing-width tracking (frame/box motion values + ResizeObserver) is dropped; the display text still sizes the box in flow and the control overlays it absolutely.
React render-time external-value sync maps to a `$effect` sync; `useSyncExternalStore` hydration guard for reduced motion is moot with no motion wired.
